location: Carrollton, Hollygrove, Mid-City, Lakeview & Bayou Saint John
heroIntro: Councilmember {councilDisplayName} and {influencerIntro} are supporting District {district}'s hospitality businesses this summer with a special night out to three local favorites across Uptown, Carrollton, Hollygrove, Mid-City, Bayou Saint John and Lakeview!
Vote to decide {councilFirstName} & {influencerFirstName}'s last stop of the night & become a Local Legend by checking in at neighborhood restaurants, bars, music venues and more all summer long!
councilQuote: This isn't just about nightlife; it's about connecting with the community where they are. We're breaking down the walls of City Hall.
influencerQuote: District {district} has some of the most vibrant, unsung spots in the city. I can't wait to show everyone what makes this neighborhood tick.

stops.title: {influencerName}'s Happy Hour Hangout
stops.body: Start the night undwinding with good people.{influencerName} opens the crawl at a spot built for conversation and an authenticlook at what makes District A tick.

stops.title: {councilName}'s Neighborhood Anchor
stops.body: Stop two lands at a local favorite hand-picked by Councilmember {councilName}: a place where neighbors actually gather, the menu knows your name, and civic talk feels welcome.

stops.title: The District A Vote
stops.body: You pick the finale. Cast your vote for the third stop before the crawl and help decide which {location} venue gets the spotlight on March 5.
